mainText: Hello, Verona! At 11 PM, it is 42 degrees with clear skies at Harriet Park and a first quarter moon overhead. The overnight low will drop to 37 degrees, and there is no rain in the forecast.

The Public Works Department is currently highlighting their year-round maintenance responsibilities for city streets, sidewalks, and utilities, while the city continues to encourage residents to subscribe to the digital newsletter for updates on local projects and programs.
There is plenty to do around town, including live music at Paddy Mac's, yoga sessions at Insight Wellness, and pizza and a pitcher at Lake Lou-ee, all happening tomorrow.

During the week of November 1st, officers handled several incidents, including a case on November 8 where a driver was arrested for O W I after a single-vehicle crash on South Main Street caused their vehicle to catch fire.
